publish.xiaohongshu:
**一句话做一条视频，我可能真的把剪辑师省掉了**

以前做一条视频的流程：
写脚本 → 找素材 → 配音 → 剪辑 → 加字幕 → 导出，一天没了。

现在：
1. 给一张自己的 IP 形象图（锁住角色一致性）
2. 写一段大白话逐字稿（不用写分镜）
3. 说一句「出片」

剩下的它自己干：
拆镜头 ✓ 配音 ✓ 字幕 ✓ 动画课件 ✓ 渲染成片 ✓

关键差别是从「抽卡」变成「可控」——每一帧都能改，字幕时长、动画节奏、转场方式全都算得出来，不满意不用重新抽，改一行重渲就行。

56 秒 / 6 个分镜 / 不到 100 积分 / 横竖屏双版本

youtube.desc:
把「写脚本 → 录音 → 剪辑」压成一句话，整条生产线塞进 WorkBuddy。

卡通 IP 在右下角讲课，课件是代码驱动的动画，字幕逐字跟读高亮，同一份工程一键出横屏与竖屏两版。

三个角色分工：
• Miora —— 生成画面素材
• Remotion —— 精确控制每一帧
• WorkBuddy —— 拆镜头、配音、配字幕、渲染成片

不抽卡、可逐帧修改，不满意改一行重渲即可。

技术栈：Remotion + 小米 MiMo / Edge TTS + ffmpeg，全本地运行，不需要剪辑软件。
youtube.descEn:
I compressed "write a script, record voiceover, edit" into one sentence — and moved the entire pipeline inside WorkBuddy.

A cartoon host lectures from the bottom-right corner. The slides are animated in code. Captions highlight word by word. One single project renders both 16:9 and 9:16.

Three roles share the work:
• Miora — generates the visual assets
• Remotion — controls every single frame
• WorkBuddy — splits shots, dubs, captions, renders

No prompt roulette. Every frame stays editable, so nothing has to be re-rolled.

Stack: Remotion + MiMo / Edge TTS + ffmpeg. Fully local, no editing software involved.

cues: Making a video means writing the script, finding footage, dubbing, editing—
a whole day gone. But with WorkBuddy,
you just say one sentence.
It splits the whole pipeline into three roles:
Miora creates the visuals,
Remotion controls the timing,
WorkBuddy runs the show.
Step one: drop in one character image.
Step two: write a plain script.
Step three: let it cut shots, dub and caption on its own,
then render the final cut.
The old way is prompt roulette—
if a frame looks wrong, you start over.
Switch to code-driven,
and every frame is editable.
Caption length, animation rhythm, transitions—all precisely controlled.
A one-minute video
with six shots, full voiceover, synced captions and animated slides
costs under 100 credits.
Remember three things: lock the character with an image,
manage the content with a script,
control the rhythm with code.
WorkBuddy does the rest.
This whole workflow is now a skill.
Next episode, I will use it to make one for you.
